# APU instruction encodings

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_apu_docs.py from a live apuasm and apudisasm run: do not edit by hand. -->

Every instruction is one 16-bit word, written big-endian: the top five bits are the opcode, the low eleven are operands. Each row below is a form that `apuasm` accepts, with the word it assembles to, split as `ooooo xxxxxxxxxxx`, and what `apudisasm` prints for that word. What each instruction does is in [instruction-set.md](instruction-set.md).

## Control flow

| Form | Word | `ooooo xxxxxxxxxxx` | Disassembles as |
|------|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| `NOP 0` | `0000` | `00000 00000000000` | `NOP` |
| `NOP $100` | `0100` | `00000 00100000000` | `NOP 256` |
| `JMP target` | `0801` | `00001 00000000001` | `JMP $01` |
| `JMP 0, 1, $20` | `0920` | `00001 00100100000` | `JMP 0, 1, $20` |
| `JMP 0, 0, $20` | `0A20` | `00001 01000100000` | `JMP 0, 0, $20` |
| `JNZ X, $20` | `1020` | `00010 00000100000` | `JNZ X, $20` |
| `JNZ Y, $20` | `1420` | `00010 10000100000` | `JNZ Y, $20` |
| `JZ X, $20` | `1320` | `00010 01100100000` | `JZ X, 1, $20` |
| `JZ X, 0, $20` | `1120` | `00010 00100100000` | `JZ X, 0, $20` |
| `JZ Y, 1, $20` | `1720` | `00010 11100100000` | `JZ Y, 1, $20` |
| `JMS $20` | `A820` | `10101 00000100000` | `JMS $20` |
| `JSR $20` | `AA20` | `10101 01000100000` | `JSR $20` |
| `JDP` | `AC00` | `10101 10000000000` | `JDP` |
| `JDPS` | `AE00` | `10101 11000000000` | `JDPS` |
| `JMX` | `F000` | `11110 00000000000` | `JMX` |
| `JSX` | `F400` | `11110 10000000000` | `JSX` |
| `RET` | `B840` | `10111 00001000000` | `RET` |
